CONTAINS.description: Parent-child hierarchical containment. The source contains the target as a sub-element.

BELONGS_TO.description: Reverse of CONTAINS — the source is a child of the target.

DESCRIBES.description: High-level narrative describes a lower-level implementation. The source provides context or explanation for the target.

IMPLEMENTS.description: Implementation realizes a narrative. The source concretely implements what the target describes.

VALIDATES.description: The source tests or verifies understanding of the target. Assessments validate concepts, scenarios validate features.

RELATES_TO.description: Generic bidirectional association between content. Used when a more specific relationship type does not apply.

REFERENCES.description: The source cites or references the target. A weaker form of RELATES_TO indicating directional citation.

DEPENDS_ON.description: The source depends on the target for correctness or completeness. Implies the target should exist for the source to be meaningful.

REQUIRES.description: The source has a prerequisite relationship with the target. Learners must complete the target before the source.

FOLLOWS.description: Sequential ordering — the source comes after the target in a learning sequence. Suggests but does not require completion order.

ATTACHED_TO.description: Attachment link — the source is attached supplementary material for the target (e.g., a story with attached media).
